title: The City Keeps Oaths
logline: When a luminous road refuses to carry her city, adult pathwright Sola Merrow discovers that every bridge is a kept promise—and that the ruling magistrate has been feeding the city stolen vows.

chapters.title: The Road Refuses
chapters.opening_condition: Sola trusts civic procedure more than people while repairing a routine skyroad fault.
chapters.objective: Keep the East Span open through evening crossing.
chapters.closing_turn: The road names Sola as a witness and points toward a concealed fracture beneath the city.

sequences.name: Hairline Light
sequences.setting: East Span above a blue cloud sea at dawn
sequences.objective: Diagnose a flickering route seam before commuters arrive
sequences.escalation: The roadlight recoils from Sola's official seal and a whole lane goes dark
sequences.action: Sola kneels, removes her glove, and feels a second pulse inside the stone
sequences.choice: She breaks procedure and listens with her bare copper bracer
sequences.consequence: A hidden gold line answers in the rhythm of a human heartbeat

sequences.name: Weight of Morning
sequences.setting: East Span commuter terrace with pearl pylons
sequences.objective: Evacuate adults before the dark lane shears away
sequences.escalation: The terrace tilts and the nearest pylon loses its luminous anchor
sequences.action: Tarin plants his warden spear-key while Sola redirects commuters one row at a time
sequences.choice: Sola abandons her costly tool case to pull a stranger across
sequences.consequence: The lane falls, the adults live, and Sola's instruments vanish into cloud

sequences.name: Terms of Repair
sequences.setting: quiet maintenance alcove beneath East Span
sequences.objective: Stabilize the remaining span with emergency authority
sequences.escalation: Tarin's badge opens the control iris but the roadlight rejects him too
sequences.action: Sola and Tarin compare their pulses against the dim seam
sequences.choice: Tarin admits the badge is backed by an oath the wardens no longer keep
sequences.consequence: The seam brightens only when he speaks the truth
letters: TARIN|We stopped protecting the lower terraces.

sequences.name: The Witness Line
sequences.setting: broken East Span edge at violet dusk
sequences.objective: Create a temporary crossing for stranded residents
sequences.escalation: The official emergency cable unthreads in Sola's hands
sequences.action: Sola promises aloud to stay until every resident crosses
sequences.choice: She locks her copper bracer around the exposed gold pulse despite unknown risk
sequences.consequence: A narrow bridge of light forms; a gold witness line circles her wrist and points below
letters: SOLA|I stay until the last of you crosses.

chapters.title: A Promise Has Weight
chapters.opening_condition: Sola bears a new luminous wrist line and has lost her professional tools.
chapters.objective: Identify what spoke through the East Span before officials seal the evidence.
chapters.closing_turn: Sola earns the Listen chord and hears thousands of strained promises beneath Caelune.

sequences.name: After the Last Crossing
sequences.setting: empty East Span in blue predawn silence
sequences.objective: Complete Sola's spoken promise and test whether the mark fades
sequences.escalation: One frightened resident remains frozen halfway across
sequences.action: Sola crosses back alone and matches her breathing to the road pulse
sequences.choice: She offers her unmarked hand rather than ordering the resident forward
sequences.consequence: The resident arrives safely; the wrist line settles instead of disappearing

sequences.name: Archive of Feet
sequences.setting: sunlit civic archive with suspended route rubbings
sequences.objective: Ask archivist Kesin for records of speaking roads
sequences.escalation: Official ledgers omit every lower-terrace oath older than thirty years
sequences.action: Kesin reveals a forbidden rubbing that reacts to Sola's wrist
sequences.choice: Sola permits Kesin to copy the mark but refuses to surrender her bracer
sequences.consequence: The rubbing maps a sealed descent into the underways
letters: KESIN|Roads don't speak in the official index.
SOLA|Copy the light. The bracer stays.

sequences.name: The Unkept Stair
sequences.setting: spiral stair descending through pale stone ribs
sequences.objective: Reach the hidden oath chamber beneath East Span
sequences.escalation: Each landing vanishes unless someone states a true obligation
sequences.action: The three adults alternate honest promises to reveal the next steps
sequences.choice: Tarin promises to oppose his own command if it endangers residents
sequences.consequence: His badge develops a black hairline crack while the final landing appears
letters: SOLA|I will record what we find.
TARIN|Even if my commander orders me.

sequences.name: Listen
sequences.setting: vast dark oath chamber threaded by sparse gold lines
sequences.objective: Read the chamber without triggering a collapse
sequences.escalation: Thousands of overlapping pulses overwhelm Sola and buckle her knees
sequences.action: She isolates the quietest repeated beat instead of chasing the loudest
sequences.choice: Sola accepts the pain of hearing unfinished public obligations
sequences.consequence: Her bracer opens into the first Listen chord and reveals the Lower Crescent failing next

chapters.title: The Badge at the Edge
chapters.opening_condition: Sola can hear unfinished oaths but is exhausted; Tarin's badge is visibly cracked.
chapters.objective: Reach Lower Crescent and prevent the forecast collapse.
chapters.closing_turn: Tarin loses his badge, and Sola earns Hold by taking responsibility for a district officials abandoned.

sequences.name: Closed Gate
sequences.setting: white gatehouse above the terraced Lower Crescent
sequences.objective: Pass the official blockade before the failure window
sequences.escalation: Commander Varo orders Tarin to arrest Sola and confiscate the archive rubbing
sequences.action: Tarin uses his cracked badge to open the gate one final time
sequences.choice: He hands the badge to Varo and steps through as a civilian
sequences.consequence: The badge goes dark; Varo marks all three as obstructors

sequences.name: Six Quiet Streets
sequences.setting: simple residential terraces beneath immense floating slabs
sequences.objective: Find the district's original supporting promise
sequences.escalation: Residents distrust civic workers and conceal the oldest marker
sequences.action: Sola repairs a mundane water rail without asking for authority
sequences.choice: She listens to complaints instead of defending the city office
sequences.consequence: A baker reveals a worn communal oathstone under the square
letters: RESIDENT|The city remembers us only when we fall.
SOLA|No speeches. Tell me what broke.

sequences.name: Holdfast
sequences.setting: open square with a single weathered oathstone
sequences.objective: Reactivate the communal anchor before the slab slips
sequences.escalation: The old oath requires a current responsible witness, not a historical quotation
sequences.action: Residents speak specific mutual duties while Sola conducts their pulses
sequences.choice: Sola adds her own career and safety to the terms of repair
sequences.consequence: A broad cyan-gold Hold chord forms across her forearm and the square steadies
letters: SOLA|And I stake my office on the truth.

sequences.name: The Other Hand
sequences.setting: roofline overlooking stabilized Lower Crescent at sunset
sequences.objective: Trace the foreign pulse fighting Sola's new Hold chord
sequences.escalation: A distant figure draws light out of an abandoned bridge with a mirrored gauntlet
sequences.action: Sola uses Listen and sees the stolen lines converge on Magistrate Serac Dain
sequences.choice: She lets him see that she recognizes the theft
sequences.consequence: Serac smiles, severs the distant bridge, and invites her to the council

chapters.title: The Wound Beneath
chapters.opening_condition: Lower Crescent is stable but temporary; Sola bears Listen and Hold chords.
chapters.objective: Find the machinery stealing civic oaths before meeting Serac.
chapters.closing_turn: Sola survives a lattice rupture with a lasting forearm fracture and proof that Serac's system consumes completed promises.

sequences.name: A Clean Invitation
sequences.setting: minimal council antechamber of ivory stone and dark glass
sequences.objective: Learn Serac's public explanation without revealing all evidence
sequences.escalation: Serac offers Sola authority over repairs if she signs a broad obedience oath
sequences.action: Sola uses Listen on the contract while Tarin watches exits
sequences.choice: She refuses the undefined promise and asks for measurable terms
sequences.consequence: The contract's gold surface reveals black stolen threads beneath
letters: SERAC|You could repair the whole city.

sequences.name: Service Passage
sequences.setting: narrow silent passage behind the council chamber
sequences.objective: Follow the black thread to its source
sequences.escalation: The passage seals and releases a faceless knotglass sentinel
sequences.action: Tarin fixes its attention while Sola reads the single binding seam
sequences.choice: Kesin burns the forbidden rubbing to reveal the sentinel's true route
sequences.consequence: The sentinel opens and the unique archive evidence is lost
letters: KESIN|That thing has no oath of its own.

sequences.name: The Oath Mill
sequences.setting: colossal vertical chamber with sparse rings of harvested light
sequences.objective: Document the hidden extraction engine
sequences.escalation: The mill recognizes Sola's Hold chord as fresh fuel and pulls her toward a ring
sequences.action: Tarin anchors her belt while Kesin records the machine by hand
sequences.choice: Sola presses Listen deeper to identify whose promises are trapped
sequences.consequence: The ring ruptures and a luminous fracture runs through Sola's left forearm
letters: SOLA|Not until I know their names.

sequences.name: Proof With a Pulse
sequences.setting: quiet rain balcony outside the mill vent
sequences.objective: Escape with admissible evidence and stabilize Sola's injury
sequences.escalation: Her new fracture emits the same black-gold rhythm as Serac's contract
sequences.action: Tarin splints the arm with his spear shaft while Kesin transcribes the pulse
sequences.choice: Sola refuses to erase the painful mark because it is living proof
sequences.consequence: They leave with a pulse record; Sola's sleeve is cut short and arm remains braced

chapters.title: The Terms of Rescue
chapters.opening_condition: Sola's left arm is splinted and her Hold chord unstable; the group has proof but is outlawed.
chapters.objective: Move Lower Crescent residents to safety before Serac accelerates extraction.
chapters.closing_turn: A community-built crossing earns Sola the Span chord, proving power can be distributed instead of owned.

sequences.name: No Empty Orders
sequences.setting: Lower Crescent square under clear morning light
sequences.objective: Organize evacuation without warden authority
sequences.escalation: Residents refuse another vague promise of temporary shelter
sequences.action: Sola publishes exact capacities, routes, and return conditions on local boards
sequences.choice: She gives residents veto power over the route
sequences.consequence: Three adult neighborhood stewards agree to lead the convoy
letters: SOLA|No one moves on trust alone.

sequences.name: The Narrow Air
sequences.setting: broken service road between two pale floating slabs
sequences.objective: Move the first convoy across a shrinking route
sequences.escalation: Sola's Hold chord flickers and the rear half of the convoy stalls
sequences.action: Tarin turns his spear sideways into a handrail while Sola calls the walking cadence
sequences.choice: They send supplies back to reduce load rather than divide families
sequences.consequence: The convoy crosses hungry but together; Tarin's spear bends permanently

sequences.name: Promises in Parallel
sequences.setting: open gap with isolated bridge piers and vast negative space
sequences.objective: Cross the final gap after the road disappears
sequences.escalation: No single witness can carry enough obligation to form a bridge
sequences.action: Each steward names one concrete duty while Sola aligns their light
sequences.choice: Sola stops trying to be the sole anchor and lets the terms remain separately owned
sequences.consequence: Parallel bands knit into the first distributed Span chord
letters: STEWARD|I keep the eastern shelter open.

sequences.name: The Magistrate's Horizon
sequences.setting: safe terrace facing the distant council crown at night
sequences.objective: Confirm everyone is accounted for and understand Serac's response
sequences.escalation: Serac illuminates the oath mill openly and begins drawing from multiple districts
sequences.action: Sola extends Span as a listening network through resident-held lines
sequences.choice: She warns the entire city instead of hiding the method for leverage
sequences.consequence: Caelune sees black fractures in its roads; Serac declares Sola an enemy of continuity
letters: SOLA|Then every district gets the truth.

chapters.title: A City in Two Voices
chapters.opening_condition: The theft is public; Sola has Listen, unstable Hold, and distributed Span.
chapters.objective: Win a public suspension of the oath mill before the city divides.
chapters.closing_turn: The council chooses Serac's false stability, and an outer district is sacrificed as the cost.

sequences.name: A Shorter Coat
sequences.setting: simple shelter workshop before the hearing
sequences.objective: Prepare evidence and practical clothing for Sola's injured arm
sequences.escalation: The splint prevents her from wearing the intact long coat
sequences.action: Tarin cuts and hems the coat while Kesin organizes witness statements
sequences.choice: Sola removes her civic rank pins and leaves the torn sleeve visible
sequences.consequence: She enters in a short navy field coat, ivory brace, ochre scarf, and no rank

sequences.name: Specific Witnesses
sequences.setting: bright circular council forum with ample empty stone
sequences.objective: Present verifiable evidence of the mill's theft
sequences.escalation: Serac reframes every harmed district as a necessary sacrifice
sequences.action: Residents state exact completed promises that the machine consumed
sequences.choice: Sola lets their testimony lead instead of performing her powers
sequences.consequence: Half the council votes to suspend the mill; half demands stronger continuity
letters: SERAC|A city survives by choosing losses.

sequences.name: The First Compact
sequences.setting: council floor beneath a suspended ancient covenant disc
sequences.objective: Invoke Caelune's founding compact to force an audit
sequences.escalation: The disc reveals the compact's witness name has been deliberately erased
sequences.action: Sola uses Span to connect the disc with the pulse record
sequences.choice: Tarin publicly identifies Commander Varo's authorization seal on the erasure
sequences.consequence: Varo arrests Tarin while the disc begins to speak one surviving clause

sequences.name: Necessary Loss
sequences.setting: forum windows overlooking the distant Outer Lantern district
sequences.objective: Stop Serac from proving his doctrine through a live sacrifice
sequences.escalation: Serac redirects the mill; Outer Lantern begins descending
sequences.action: Sola throws Span toward the district but her injured Hold chord collapses
sequences.choice: She remains to free Tarin's witnesses instead of leaping alone into an unwinnable gap
sequences.consequence: Outer Lantern drops out of sight but transmits an evacuation pulse; the council grants Serac emergency power
letters: KESIN|If you jump, he wins twice.

chapters.title: The Broken Spear
chapters.opening_condition: Tarin is detained, Sola's Hold chord is gone, and Serac controls the city by emergency decree.
chapters.objective: Free Tarin and seize the mill's routing key.
chapters.closing_turn: The key is won, but Tarin's spear is broken and Sola learns Serac is bound to keep the city aloft at any human cost.

sequences.name: No Hero Entrance
sequences.setting: quiet detention service court in gray rain
sequences.objective: Enter detention using distributed civic roles
sequences.escalation: Emergency locks recognize Sola and seal every direct approach
sequences.action: Stewards separately fulfill ordinary delivery, sanitation, and counsel duties
sequences.choice: Sola stays hidden and lets uncelebrated work create the route
sequences.consequence: Three legal doors open in sequence without breaking any lock

sequences.name: The Key and the Cage
sequences.setting: minimal white detention gallery
sequences.objective: Release Tarin and obtain Varo's routing key
sequences.escalation: Varo offers Tarin his badge back for testimony against Sola
sequences.action: Tarin snaps the returned badge in the lock while Sola spans the fragments
sequences.choice: Sola saves Varo when the overloaded door lashes inward
sequences.consequence: Tarin is free, Varo lives, and the routing key falls loose

sequences.name: Against the Mill
sequences.setting: oath mill access bridge with strong vertical depth
sequences.objective: Insert the routing key and halt district extraction
sequences.escalation: Two sentinels attack from opposite planes while the bridge rotates
sequences.action: Tarin uses his bent spear as a fork to pin both seams for Sola
sequences.choice: He holds past the weapon's tolerance so she can reach the keyway
sequences.consequence: The spear shatters; Sola inserts the key and freezes the extraction rings

sequences.name: His One True Term
sequences.setting: still center of the frozen oath mill
sequences.objective: Read Serac's core binding while the machine is silent
sequences.escalation: Serac arrives and willingly exposes a brilliant vow line through his chest
sequences.action: Sola listens and hears a sincere promise to keep Caelune aloft
sequences.choice: She rejects the easy claim that he is simply lying
sequences.consequence: The mill restarts remotely; Serac escapes, and Sola realizes his truthful vow has monstrous undefined costs
letters: SERAC|I have never broken my oath.
TARIN|Truth can still be a weapon.

chapters.title: The Cost of Unmaking
chapters.opening_condition: The group holds the routing key map but the mill runs; Sola has Listen and Span only.
chapters.objective: Learn Sever, the forbidden chord that can release stolen obligations.
chapters.closing_turn: Sola relinquishes her pathwright office to earn Sever and frees the trapped vows, triggering Caelune's unsupported descent.

sequences.name: A Chord With No Owners
sequences.setting: abandoned pathwright school courtyard at dawn
sequences.objective: Find a lawful method to separate vows from Serac's machine
sequences.escalation: The sealed lesson states Sever requires surrendering a genuinely kept identity vow
sequences.action: Sola tests trivial promises and the lesson remains dark
sequences.choice: She admits being a pathwright has governed every choice she makes
sequences.consequence: The courtyard marks her office as the only adequate cost
letters: SOLA|I have always been a pathwright.

sequences.name: Before the Name Leaves
sequences.setting: simple bench beneath a single luminous tree
sequences.objective: Decide whether Sola will surrender her office
sequences.escalation: Without the title she loses legal craft access and the future she built
sequences.action: Tarin places the two halves of his spear beside her, offering no instruction
sequences.choice: Sola asks whether he will still walk with her when she cannot repair every road
sequences.consequence: Tarin promises partnership without condition of usefulness
letters: SOLA|If I do this, I am not a pathwright.
SOLA|That was supposed to sound worse.
SOLA|Will you still walk with me?

sequences.name: Sever
sequences.setting: oath mill core with restrained black and gold rings
sequences.objective: Release every stolen completed vow
sequences.escalation: The mill binds Sola's own career pledge into its defenses
sequences.action: She removes her copper bracer and breaks her pathwright seal across the keyway
sequences.choice: Sola renounces exclusive authority over roads and accepts permanent loss
sequences.consequence: A clean white Sever chord crosses her palm; captive lines stream free
letters: SOLA|No road belongs to one office.

sequences.name: Unsupported
sequences.setting: citywide vista of crescent slabs beginning to descend
sequences.objective: Understand the immediate consequence of freeing the vows
sequences.escalation: The stolen power was masking decades of missing public support
sequences.action: Sola uses Listen across Span to count independent district failures
sequences.choice: She broadcasts the true descent time instead of offering false reassurance
sequences.consequence: Caelune has one night; Serac heads for the founding disc to seize direct control
letters: KESIN|The mill was the only support.
SOLA|No. It hid the missing support.
SERAC|Then the city needs one will.

chapters.title: Every Witness
chapters.opening_condition: Caelune is descending; Sola has Listen, Span, and Sever but no office, bracer, or Hold.
chapters.objective: Replace singular control with a citywide network of specific voluntary promises.
chapters.closing_turn: The Chorus mantle forms, Outer Lantern answers from below, and Caelune gains one final chance.

sequences.name: Terms People Can Keep
sequences.setting: open market terrace under a slowly rising horizon
sequences.objective: Gather support without repeating Serac's coercion
sequences.escalation: Panicked adults offer grand impossible vows that produce unstable glare
sequences.action: Sola severs the vague promises before they can bind
sequences.choice: She asks for small duties with named limits and witnesses
sequences.consequence: Hundreds of calm separate lights appear across the market
letters: SOLA|No. That promise will eat you.
BAKER|I feed forty people until dawn.

sequences.name: The Chorus Fork
sequences.setting: quiet forge with one amber furnace
sequences.objective: Give Tarin a tool that conducts rather than commands
sequences.escalation: His shattered spear cannot be restored without recreating warden authority
sequences.action: The smith melts the badge fragments into the broken spear's two tines
sequences.choice: Tarin chooses a short open fork with no blade
sequences.consequence: The chorus fork resonates with nearby voluntary lines
letters: SMITH|I can make the spear again.

sequences.name: Outer Lantern Answers
sequences.setting: highest signal terrace above enormous cloud depth
sequences.objective: Extend Span far enough to include every district
sequences.escalation: The network remains one anchor short and starts tearing Sola's injured arm
sequences.action: Tarin conducts the bounded vows while Kesin names each district
sequences.choice: Sola leaves space for the sacrificed district rather than closing the circuit
sequences.consequence: A distant cyan signal rises from Outer Lantern survivors below

sequences.name: Chorus
sequences.setting: night sky above Caelune filled with sparse converging vowlines
sequences.objective: Bind the independent promises without taking ownership
sequences.escalation: The lines converge on Sola and threaten to crown her as sole controller
sequences.action: She routes every line back through its original witness
sequences.choice: Sola accepts responsibility for coordination but refuses possession
sequences.consequence: A translucent cyan-gold Chorus mantle forms over her short coat; the city descent slows
letters: SOLA|I coordinate. I do not own.

chapters.title: What Holds
chapters.opening_condition: Caelune's descent is slowed by Chorus; Serac is taking control of the founding disc.
chapters.objective: Restore the founding compact before the city crosses the irreversible fall line.
chapters.closing_turn: Caelune holds through distributed covenants, Serac is deposed, and distant abandoned roads begin answering Sola's Chorus.

sequences.name: The Vertical Road
sequences.setting: founding chamber exterior as the city falls through luminous cloud
sequences.objective: Reach the disc along a road now oriented straight upward
sequences.escalation: Sentinels cut witness lines, forcing the trio onto separate surfaces
sequences.action: Tarin conducts timing, Kesin calls geometry, and Sola spans three planes
sequences.choice: Sola trusts each adult to hold an unseen segment
sequences.consequence: They climb as a triangle and enter the chamber together

sequences.name: One Will
sequences.setting: vast clean founding chamber around a brilliant suspended disc
sequences.objective: Prevent Serac from binding every city vow to himself
sequences.escalation: Serac wears a blinding mantle made from unbounded emergency promises
sequences.action: Sola severs only the vague terms while preserving his sincere core vow
sequences.choice: She refuses to destroy him or the promise to keep Caelune aloft
sequences.consequence: His borrowed mantle falls away, leaving one exposed gold line
letters: SOLA|One cost. Paid by everyone else.

sequences.name: The Missing Witness
sequences.setting: disc interior rendered as open white space and one gold inscription
sequences.objective: Restore the erased founding witness and bounded terms
sequences.escalation: The original witness was not a ruler but the assembled districts, so no single name can replace it
sequences.action: Kesin reads the surviving clause while Tarin carries every district response through the fork
sequences.choice: Sola offers the disc no name—only the living network and its right to withdraw
sequences.consequence: The disc accepts a plural witness and strips Serac of emergency authority
letters: KESIN|The witness was never one person.
SOLA|No owner. Every witness may withdraw.

sequences.name: The City Holds Itself
sequences.setting: sunrise across stabilized crescent districts and clear vertical depth
sequences.objective: Complete stabilization and account for the conflict
sequences.escalation: The last descent surge tests every bounded promise at once
sequences.action: Citizens fulfill their stated duties while Sola conducts Chorus and Tarin grounds the disc
sequences.choice: Sola lets the network bear visible uneven strain instead of forcing perfect control
sequences.consequence: Caelune stops; Varo detains Serac under restored law, Outer Lantern rises on rescue lines, and far-off abandoned roads answer Sola
letters: SOLA|Hold what you promised. No more.
